rules.rule: PageSpec.template must be generationEligible in templates.json (template.legal is not: never captured).
PageSpec.route must be one of its template's routes; template.home is homeRouteOnly ('/').
Node (section,variant) sequence must equal the declared template's node list in order: every required node present, no extra or repeated nodes, no reordering.
All shell.* nodes precede every scroll-content node (fixed overlays mounted before the scroll story).
Exactly one hero.copy, and it is the first non-shell node, immediately followed by hero.video.
rules.exception: template.legal has no hero but is not generation-eligible, so the rule never runs against it.

rules.rule: deck.word-reveal-copy, deck.email-stack, deck.triage-game are contiguous and in that order (one sticky frame, one 3-step scroll float).
expand.compose-demo, expand.be-here-now, expand.search-demo, expand.notifications-demo are contiguous and in that order (one sticky frame, one integer state 0..6).
Final three nodes are footer.launch, proof.reviews-carousel, footer.bar (real DOM order inside <footer>); footer.bar is last.
shell.progress-dots content.stopCount equals the template's scrollStops length (13).
shell.scroll-hint hiddenOnStops must all be stop ids of the template.
Each node's motion pattern/trigger/reducedMotionFallback equals its section contract's motion.
Every budgeted text field obeys its section contract's fieldBudgets maxWords.
assetRef must be in the role's allowedRefs; generate-new-allowed roles carry no assetRef; sender-photo avatars must be bound to the card's sender.
Warn if more than 3 nodes carry video asset roles (the measured page has exactly 3: hero.video, expand.compose-demo, expand.be-here-now).
Warn if deck.email-stack has fewer than 4 cards: the source shows 2 swiped cards plus a visible stack behind them.

In a `generated` PageSpec no assetRole may have availability reference-only or blocked-for-generation (Avec logo/glyph/app icon, TestFlight/App Store and Outlook/Android marks, product videos and frames, sender photos); the registry's generationSafeSubstitutes name the replacement.
In a `generated` PageSpec every assetRole must be listed in that section's generatedAssetRoles, and meta.copyOrigin (content.original-copy) must be present.
In a `generated` PageSpec no string may name or imitate the Avec brand (sourceBrand.patterns.brand).

In a `generated` PageSpec no string may name an App Store, TestFlight or Outlook/Android mark (sourceBrand.patterns.storeMarks). Generic mentions are blocked too: the validator cannot tell a mark from a mention.

In a `generated` PageSpec no string may carry a source URL (TestFlight link, avec.ai, social profiles), and every URL-like string must be a placeholder (#, relative path, example.com|org|net, mailto at example.*).
In a `generated` PageSpec no string may carry a real App Store review, reviewer name, review title or review id.
In a `generated` PageSpec no string may carry the source's rating values (5.0, 400+ reviews); the rating is the schema-pinned placeholder.
In a `generated` PageSpec no string may carry a source demo persona, sender or named third-party sender identity (sourceBrand.patterns.people).
In a `generated` PageSpec no string may reference a source media file, path or content hash (sourceBrand.patterns.media).
In a `generated` PageSpec no string may carry a known Avec marketing claim (sourceBrand.patterns.copy) or a 5-word run copied from the source's own section copy.
Every sections/*.json satisfies the closed schema/section-contract.schema.json; semantic.id equals the contract id.
semantic.category of every section equals the table pinned in semantic_validate.py (and independently in verify_all.py); an unpinned section id is an error.
Sections whose content carries CTA fields are classed hero, shell, cta or layer; review content is classed proof; conversion blocks are never generic content or feature.

retrievalEligible is a closed boolean pinned per section (default true); runtime/utility UI (the notify modal, the scroll hint) is false with a retrievalReason of 30+ characters; an id that looks like cookie/consent/modal/dialog/overlay/toast/drawer is false.
source is a closed provenance object: lines 'a-b' with 1 <= a <= b, a project-relative file, source.id never equal to the contract id, no two contracts claim the same file range.

notEnforced.reason: Deliberately not applied: on this site same-category adjacency is the structure itself (SHELL x4, DECK x3, EXPAND x4 share one sticky frame each). Enforcing it would reject the only real page.
